counting: R0134/R0135 count declaration points, surrounding explanatory comments/conditional scaffolding are not assigned to these declaration anchors. R0136 counts the entire current function including comments and blanks (42 lines), historical 40-line anchor is stale. No #line counted.
counter_review: Original non-i386 globals are not the original x86 VdmTib publication. Restoring native i386 publication is not automatically appropriate for CCPU. Existing consumers prove reachability, not minimality. Decoder reuse changes address translation and exception behavior and needs explicit analysis, not an assumption of equivalence. Existing synthetic tests were inspected as references only, not newly executed or taken as whole-runtime proof.
